claim: Observed lexical index inventory only; candidate class memberships are not receiver proofs or semantic components.

definitions.function_count: distinct aliases entry keys including external and thunk rows; no claim all rows are native function bodies
definitions.membership_candidates: pairs [label_field, scope_id]; scope_id resolves in symbol-owners.jsonl, no hierarchy or semantic identity implied
definitions.membership_source_tuple: [one-based line, zero-based byte, length including LF] in aliases.jsonl
definitions.name_count: distinct exact labels across primary name and symbols[].name; equal labels in one row deduplicated, field provenance retained
definitions.owner: prefix before final top-level :: outside templates/parentheses/brackets; class vs namespace undetermined
definitions.remainder: all alias entries with no primary or symbol label containing literal ::; counts retained, exact entries/labels/locators are the complement of alias_membership rows in pinned aliases.jsonl; not discarded or classified
definitions.root: prefix before first such separator; no demangler, alias equivalence, namespace semantic interpretation or hierarchy inference
definitions.source_coordinates: one-based JSONL line; zero-based byte; length includes LF; label_field JSON pointer relative to alias row; slot indices zero-based

limits: No call traversal, runtime invocation, instruction/body/binary read or provider execution.
Template/operator parse ambiguities stay explicit; no owner guessed for malformed or nested-only separators.
Overlapping owner and root counts must not be added as a partition.
Library-path qualification is not a C++ namespace.
Vtable exporter rows can overrun into adjacent data; labels and slot-like values are observations, not table extent, method or callability proofs.

Only whole simple length-prefixed names and explicit _ZTV/_ZTS prefixes are retained as string candidates. Templates and other complex encodings remain the pinned string-source complement. Even whole simple syntax can be a method or fragment: no validated full Itanium type or class/function membership follows.
A named method narrows possible class membership only after actual receiver construction, address point, slot ABI and dispatch evidence independently join it.
No indirect site newly resolved or behavioral outcome graded by this inventory.
selfcheck: 16 assertions pass; exact source manifest digest/size/line and stat checks; membership plus remainder cardinality asserted
